integrity: An analytic all-poset/all-partition proof and independently organized deterministic exact-integer finite checks are included. No claims of independent scientific audit or exhaustive literature priority.
limitations: The theorem is for standard added-bottom/added-top chain–order polytopes with markings 0 and 1, not general multilevel marked poset polytopes. The affine dimension, not the full face lattice, of the center polytope is classified. An antecedent under two-level-polytope language remains possible.
title: Height and longest-chain coverage determine Minkowski centers of every chain–order poset polytope
